purpose: Separately labeled development/remediation study; not a continuation of prespecified QE-A inference.

split.assignment: within each stratum sort ascending by ranking_key then case_id; first exact half is development and remainder is held_out

development_budget.round_1: Run every predeclared candidate once on all 30 development cases.
development_budget.round_2: Optional deterministic confirmation of exactly one already-predeclared candidate on all 30 development cases; no prompt or gate revision is permitted between rounds.
development_budget.candidate_freeze_rule: All candidate prompts, gates, runtime settings, seeds, and schemas must be committed before the first fresh development generation.
candidate_selection_rule: Exclude any candidate that weakens polarity, modality, one-sentence, mechanical-integrity, or concrete-marker safeguards without a development positive-control justification.
Among eligible candidates, maximize the minimum development corpus-by-direction case coverage.
Then maximize overall development case coverage.
Then prefer fewer safeguard failure modes and fewer attempts per accepted case.
Break any remaining tie in favor of the candidate with fewer prompt/gate changes from QE-A v1, then lexical candidate_id order.
prohibited_selection_inputs: held-out text, acceptance, trace, or aggregate outcome

held_out_confirmation.failure_disposition: Stop QE-R and recommend omitting the Qwen edit arm and held QE-B disposition paragraph from the submitted paper.
held_out_confirmation.pass_disposition: Package accepted outputs and privacy-safe evidence, then recommend a separate primary-reviewed scoring/analysis sprint; do not score in QE-R.

privacy_and_blinding.development_text_access: Only development-half QE-A attempts, original text, author-positive-control text, and traces may be exposed locally after this split is committed.
privacy_and_blinding.held_out_text_access: Held-out originals, author edits, QE-A attempts, and fresh v2 outputs must never be printed or interactively inspected in QE-R.
privacy_and_blinding.generation_boundary: Qwen receives only the current original sentence and direction-matched prompt; author wording, gates, traces, scores, labels, corpus identity, and other cases are absent.
privacy_and_blinding.tracked_release: Case IDs, split labels, source positions, directions, aggregates, reason codes, metrics, hashes, seeds, and provenance only; no sentence or edit text.
privacy_and_blinding.raw_text_storage: Ignored outputs only, separated by development and held_out directories.
privacy_and_blinding.positive_controls: Apply gates only to development-half author edits and report aggregate metric distributions; author wording is never included in generation requests.
